items.t: GIGABYTE Partners with Newegg to Host "AORUS VS40" Esports Event for GIGABYTE's 40th Anniversary
items.sum: Celebrating 40 years of GIGABYTE, GIGABYTE has partnered with Newegg to host AORUS VS40, a free community gaming celebration taking place on Saturday, November 21, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. PST at the Newegg Gamer Zone in Diamond Bar, California.
